source.publication_status: Unreleased branch source; equal version text does not identify the published 4.1.0 wheel.

hardware.resource_policy: One worker; vendor thread caps1 before numerical imports; Torch intra/inter1; observed Apple Accelerate calling-thread BLAS mode1; Julia Threads1/BLAS1,ILP64OpenBLAS.

version_metadata_caveat: The inherited virtualenv has stale ResDAG distribution metadata 2.1.0. Actual imported source reports 4.1.0, and every runtime module origin and file hash was checked against the frozen source commit.
evaluation_boundary: Fresh reserved initialization seeds301–305. Reused raw trajectories/origins are held out from this study, not historically unseen. One trajectory per system; no independent-trajectory generalization claim.

protocol.score: Contiguous prefix before per-step RMS across training-standardized features reaches threshold; reported in reference Lyapunov times.
protocol.winner_rule: Largest median0.3validationLT; earliest trial wins exact ties. All six winners frozen before final values were sliced. No retuning, retries, aborted-study reuse or additional final attempts.
protocol.deadline: Eligibility deadline, not OS hard cap. Sampling/build/fit/history/rollout/scoring/IPC/bookkeeping charged. Incomplete/overrun candidates excluded; actual overruns and partial work retained.
protocol.common_nominal_model: Zero state; tanh leaky state; Gaussian recurrence on directed sparse pattern including self-loops, radius-rescaled; dense uniform inputs; independent uniform random bias; state-only no-intercept readout. Native masks, RNGs, storage and solvers differ.

timing_scopes.fit_build_and_training_wall_seconds: Outer adapter.fit wall includes construction, initialization, training and result/metadata collection; Julia includes binary IPC. Not reset/forecast or later policy verification.
timing_scopes.native_fit_seconds: Adapter-native fit interval; ReservoirPy lazily initializes here, whereas RD/Julia separately record build. These boundaries differ.
timing_scopes.forecast_and_scoring_wall_seconds: Outer candidate.forecast plus scoring wall; includes fresh-state500-sample synchronization and autonomous rollout, conversion and Julia IPC; history slicing and later policy verification excluded.
timing_scopes.native_forecast_seconds: Python forecast wrapper includes reset/synchronization/rollout/conversion; Julia worker interval excludes Python serialization/IPC. These scopes differ.
timing_scopes.startup_synthetic_warmup_seconds: prepare_adapter startup and one fixed synthetic warmup; common CLI imports occurred earlier, so not total process startup.
timing_scopes.timing_interpretation: Final winner timings are descriptive observations of selected configurations, not repeated matched-weight speed trials or a universal throughput ranking. Memory is per-model tensor/array bytes for Python versus Julia parameter-tree heap bytes; RSS is process high-water including startup and previous work.

warnings.interpretation: Native solvers and effective fits differ. ResDAG can increase effective alpha and PSD-project Gram; ReservoirPy uses symmetric Gram solve; Julia augmented QR. Logs use default Python warning dedup, not a warning count per fit. Preserved Julia worker stderr excludes the earlier synthetic storage pilot. All final errors and measured scores remain in the unmodified report.
